sections.title: Day 30 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
## 900+ Triple Passage × Part 3/4 高密度同義轉換

今天承接 Day 29。你已經進入第五週，因此訓練開始從「找到答案」進一步要求：

> **聽到 A → 辨認選項中的 B**  
> **看到三份文件 → 找出彼此關係**  
> **Part 5 → 10 秒左右完成詞性判斷**  
> **Reading → 分辨原始資訊、限制條件、後續行動**

目前沒有收到 Day 29 的實際作答結果，因此今天先維持 **860～900+**，提高同義改寫密度，但不再增加文章長度。

建議訓練時間：**95～105 分鐘**

sections.title: ① 今日單字｜30 個
sections.markdown:
主題：**Purchasing / Orders / Shipping**

| Word | 中文 | TOEIC 高頻搭配 |
|---|---|---|
| purchase | 購買 | make a purchase |
| order | 訂單 | place an order |
| supplier | 供應商 | contact a supplier |
| vendor | 廠商 | approved vendor |
| merchandise | 商品 | damaged merchandise |

| replenish | 補充 | replenish inventory |
| invoice | 發票／請款單 | issue an invoice |
| receipt | 收據 | keep a receipt |

今天優先做到不翻譯：

> **place an order**  
> **approved vendor**  
> **in stock**

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Part 5 高速詞性辨識 II
sections.markdown:
昨天建立：

> structure → POS → meaning

今天增加：

> **字尾辨識**

常見名詞：

> `-tion` → application / production  
> `-ment` → development / payment  
> `-ness` → effectiveness  
> `-ity` → availability / productivity

常見形容詞：

> `-ive` → effective  
> `-al` → financial  
> `-able` → available  
> `-ful` → successful

常見副詞：

> `-ly` → carefully / successfully

但要注意：

> friendly  
> costly  
> likely

雖然有 `-ly`，通常是 **形容詞**。

所以：

> 字尾只是提示，不是絕對規則。

sections.title: ③ 名詞 vs. 形容詞
sections.markdown:
> Product _____ has improved.

(A) available  
(B) availability

`Product _____` 當主詞。

需要名詞：

> **availability**

---

> The product is currently _____.

需要描述 product：

> **available**

sections.title: ④ adjective vs. adverb
sections.markdown:
> The warehouse operates _____.

需要修飾：

> operates

答案：

> **efficiently**

但是：

> The warehouse is _____.

`is` 後描述 warehouse：

> **efficient**

sections.title: ⑤ Part 5 高頻陷阱：-ed / -ing adjective
sections.markdown:
> Customers were _____ by the delay.

(A) frustrating  
(B) frustrated

Customer 感受到：

> **frustrated**

---

> The delay was _____.

造成挫折：

> **frustrating**

建立：

> something is interesting  
> someone is interested

> something is disappointing  
> someone is disappointed

sections.title: ⑥ Listening 高分核心｜Paraphrase Map
sections.markdown:
今天先建立 10 組：

| 聽到 | 選項可能寫 |
|---|---|
| almost out of | running low on |
| put off | postpone |
| come in | attend an interview |
| look over | review |
| turn down | reject |

sections.title: ⑦ Listening Set 1｜Part 3
sections.markdown:
### Q1

What problem are the speakers discussing?

(A) A product is unavailable  
(B) An invoice is incorrect  
(C) A delivery address is wrong  
(D) A payment was rejected

### Q2

What does the woman suggest?

(A) Canceling the order  
(B) Choosing another model  
(C) Waiting two months  
(D) Contacting the bank

### Q3

What will the man probably do next?

(A) Review an alternative product  
(B) Request a refund  
(C) Visit the warehouse  
(D) Change suppliers

聽力稿：

> **Man:** I just heard from the supplier about the monitors we ordered. The 27-inch model won't be back in stock for another six weeks.
>
> **Woman:** That's too long. The new employees start next Monday. What about the 24-inch version?
>
> **Man:** They said that's available immediately.
>
> **Woman:** Let's look over the specifications. If it's suitable, we can switch the order.

### 答案

**1A / 2B / 3A**

同義：

> won't be back in stock  
> → unavailable

> look over  
> → review

> switch the order  
> → choose an alternative

sections.title: ⑧ Listening Set 2｜Part 3 Intent
sections.markdown:
### Q4

Why does the woman call?

(A) To report damaged merchandise  
(B) To change a delivery address  
(C) To order more products  
(D) To request an invoice

### Q5

What does the man say about the replacement?

(A) It will cost extra  
(B) It has already been shipped  
(C) It will arrive tomorrow  
(D) It is unavailable

### Q6

Why does the woman say, “That works for me”?

(A) The proposed solution is acceptable  
(B) She wants a refund instead  
(C) She agrees with the product price  
(D) She has repaired the item herself

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** Hi, I'm calling about a desk chair that arrived this morning. One of the wheels was broken when I opened the box.
>
> **Man:** I'm sorry about that. I can send a replacement chair today. There won't be any additional charge, and it should reach you tomorrow afternoon.
>
> **Woman:** That works for me. Do you need the damaged chair back?
>
> **Man:** Yes. The carrier can collect it when the replacement is delivered.

### 答案

**4A / 5C / 6A**

注意：

> That works for me.

不是：

> 「那個替我工作。」

而是：

> **That solution is acceptable.**

sections.title: ⑨ Listening Set 3｜Part 4
sections.markdown:
### Delivery Schedule

| Service | Arrival | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Economy | Monday | $6 |
| Standard | Friday | $11 |
| Express | Thursday | $19 |
| Priority | Wednesday | $29 |

### Q7

What is being shipped?

(A) Office furniture  
(B) Product samples  
(C) Signed contracts  
(D) Computer equipment

### Q8

What requirement is mentioned?

(A) Arrival no later than Thursday  
(B) Price below $10  
(C) Wednesday delivery  
(D) International shipping

### Q9

Which service should be selected?

(A) Economy  
(B) Standard  
(C) Express  
(D) Priority

聽力稿：

> The product samples for Friday's client presentation are ready. Please send them this afternoon. We need them at the client's office by Thursday so the sales team has time to prepare. There's no reason to pay for Wednesday delivery, so select the least expensive service that meets the deadline.

### 答案

**7B / 8A / 9C**

符合 Thursday：

> Express $19  
> Priority $29

要求：

> cheapest

所以：

> **Express**

sections.title: ⑩ Listening 900+｜「合理」不等於答案
sections.markdown:
上一題：

> Standard = $11

看起來最便宜。

但是：

> Friday

不符合：

> **by Thursday**

Priority：

> Wednesday

符合，但：

> 多花 $10，沒有必要。

因此 TOEIC 高分題常要求：

> **Constraint → eliminate → optimize**

而不是：

> 找到一個看起來合理的選項。

sections.title: ⑪ Reading｜Triple Passage
sections.markdown:
今天提高一級。

先建立：

> Document 1 = Order  
> Document 2 = Problem  
> Document 3 = Resolution

---

## Passage 1｜Purchase Order

> **Harrison Design — Purchase Order #8412**
>
> Order Date: November 4
>
> 20 ErgoPro Office Chairs — $180 each  
> 4 Conference Tables — $450 each
>
> Requested Delivery: November 12
>
> Delivery Location: Harrison Design, 28 Green Street
>
> Special Instructions: Please contact office manager Laura Chen before delivery.

---

## Passage 2｜Supplier E-mail

> **To:** Laura Chen  
> **From:** Metro Office Supply  
> **Subject:** Purchase Order #8412
>
> Thank you for your recent order.
>
> Unfortunately, we have experienced an unexpected shortage of ErgoPro chairs. We currently have 12 available and expect another shipment to arrive November 18.
>
> The conference tables are in stock and can be delivered as originally requested.
>
> Alternatively, we have sufficient quantities of our ComfortPlus chair, which is similar in design and costs $165 per unit.
>
> Please let us know how you would like to proceed.

---

## Passage 3｜Laura's Reply

> **To:** Metro Office Supply  
> **Subject:** Re: Purchase Order #8412
>
> Thank you for letting me know.
>
> We need all twenty chairs before our new employees begin work on November 16, so waiting until November 18 won't be possible.
>
> Please replace the ErgoPro chairs in our order with twenty ComfortPlus chairs.
>
> The conference tables can be delivered on November 12 as planned.
>
> Please send me a revised invoice reflecting the new chair price before processing the payment.
>
> —Laura Chen

sections.title: ⑫ Triple Passage Questions
sections.markdown:
### Q1

How many ErgoPro chairs were originally ordered?

(A) 4  
(B) 12  
(C) 18  
(D) 20

### Q2

Why does Metro Office Supply contact Laura?

(A) The delivery address is incorrect  
(B) One product is in short supply  
(C) Payment was rejected  
(D) The tables were damaged

### Q3

How many ErgoPro chairs are currently available?

(A) 4  
(B) 12  
(C) 16  
(D) 20

### Q4

Why can't Laura wait until November 18?

(A) The price will increase  
(B) Employees need the chairs before then  
(C) The office will close  
(D) The tables arrive earlier

### Q5

What does Laura decide to do?

(A) Cancel the entire order  
(B) Order only 12 chairs  
(C) Substitute another chair model  
(D) Delay the employee start date

### Q6

How much will the 20 replacement chairs cost?

(A) $3,000  
(B) $3,300  
(C) $3,600  
(D) $4,500

Calculation:

> 20 × $165 = **$3,300**

答案：

**B**

### Q7

What will Metro Office Supply most likely do before processing payment?

(A) Deliver the chairs  
(B) Contact the employees  
(C) Send a revised invoice  
(D) Cancel the tables

### 答案

**1D / 2B / 3B / 4B / 5C / 6B / 7C**

sections.title: ⑬ Triple Passage 900+ 解析
sections.markdown:
這次三份文件不是單純找字。

原始：

> ErgoPro ×20  
> $180

Problem：

> only 12 available  
> rest Nov 18

Constraint：

> employees start Nov 16

所以：

> Nov18 ❌

Alternative：

> ComfortPlus $165  
> sufficient stock

Decision：

> replace all 20

最後還產生新的動作：

> revised invoice  
> ↓  
> payment

因此資訊鏈：

> **Order → Shortage → Constraint → Alternative → Decision → Invoice → Payment**

這就是 Triple Passage 最重要的能力。

sections.title: ⑯ 小考解析
sections.markdown:
**Q1**

> The _____ of...

需要：

> noun

`purchase` 可以當名詞：

> the purchase of inventory

---

**Q2**

修飾：

> worked

需要副詞：

> **efficiently**

---

**Q3**

Customers 感到滿意：

> **satisfied**

服務本身：

> satisfying

---

**Q4**

delay 是造成感受的事物：

> **frustrating**

---

**Q5**

Monitor：

> unavailable six weeks

但是：

> employees start next Monday

因此時間條件不允許等待。

---

**Q6**

> look over

= **review**

這是典型 TOEIC paraphrase。

---

**Q7**

原文：

> carrier can collect it

所以：

> damaged chair → carrier pickup

---

**Q8**

Deadline：

> Thursday

Express：

> Thursday / $19

Priority：

> Wednesday / $29

要求最低成本：

> **Express**

---

**Q9**

這是 Timeline：

> employee start Nov16

> ErgoPro restock Nov18

所以：

> 18 > 16 ❌

---

**Q10**

Laura 明確要求：

> replace ErgoPro with **20 ComfortPlus**

---

**Q11**

> $165 × 20

= **$3,300**

---

**Q12**

Laura：

> send revised invoice **before processing payment**

因此：

> invoice → payment

sections.title: ⑱ 今日錯題標籤
sections.markdown:
沿用：

> G — Grammar  
> V — Vocabulary  
> L — Listening  
> P — Paraphrase  
> I — Information Integration  
> T — Timeline  
> E — Exception  
> U — Update  
> C — Condition  
> N — Next Action  
> POS — Part of Speech  
> INT — Intent

今天增加：

> **CAL — Calculation**

例如：

> 20 × $165

英文看懂但價格算錯：

> CAL

以及：

> **SEQ — Sequence**

例如：

> revised invoice → payment

如果知道兩件事情，卻弄錯發生順序：

> SEQ

第二次限制：

### Listening

> **Chair：broken → replacement tomorrow → acceptable → carrier collects old**

> employee → Nov16

sections.title: ⑳ Day 31 難度調整
sections.markdown:
如果 Day 30 第一次：

**11～12 / 12**

→ Day 31 進入 **900+ 高密度模式**，Triple Passage 不再只做「Rule → Problem → Resolution」，而會加入兩個都看似合理的條件。

**9～10 / 12**

→ 維持目前 Triple Passage，增加 Paraphrase。

**7～8 / 12**

→ Part 3/4 保留 900 難度，但 Reading 暫不增加資訊量。

**≤6 / 12**

→ Day 31 優先補 POS、P、T，再進入下一階段。

如果：

> Q1～4 錯 → **POS**

> Q5～8 錯 → **P / L / I**

> Q9～12 錯 → **T / I / CAL / SEQ**

**Day 30 核心能力：**

> 不要問「哪個答案看起來合理？」

而要問：

> **「哪個答案同時符合所有條件？」**
